The dividends for the Preferred Stock Series M and N are payable on December 15, 2026 to stockholders of record at the close of business on November 30, 2026.
The dividends for the Preferred Stock Series A, C, E, F, I, K, L, O, P and Q are payable on January 15, 2027 to stockholders of record at the close of business on December 31, 2026.
